user_data.constant_value:
#!/bin/bash
dnf install -y python3
mkdir -p /opt/three-tier-app
cat > /opt/three-tier-app/server.py <<'PYEOF'
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
import json

class AppHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        body = json.dumps({"service": "three-tier-app", "status": "healthy"}).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

HTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), AppHandler).serve_forever()
PYEOF
cat > /etc/systemd/system/three-tier-app.service <<'SVCEOF'
[Unit]
Description=Three-tier application server
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/three-tier-app/server.py
Restart=always
User=ec2-user

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
SVCEOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now three-tier-app
